name: The Glass Pits
description: A cluster of open pits where the sand has been fused into black glass, and old shafts lead down into the heat.

discovery.message: The sand ahead glitters black: fused glass, around the mouths of old mine shafts.

entrance.text: You climb down a shaft rimmed with black glass. The air gets hotter with every rung.

requirements.description: You need a light to go underground.

entrance.failure_text: Past the entrance it's black as pitch. You'd need a lit torch or lantern, or eyes that see in the dark, to go any further.

hazard.text: A sour smell hangs in the heat at the bottom of the shaft.
hazard.success_text: Gas. You hold your breath, keep your flame low and hurry through to clean air.
hazard.failure_text: The gas catches a spark and flares around you.

gas-burn.text: You stagger out of the flare, singed.

face.text: The first pit's face is streaked with iron and copper, baked hard by the heat below.

way-down.text: The tunnel beyond the face is choked with fused glass where something once burned hot enough to melt the rock. Behind it, heat breathes out of the dark.

depths-break.text: You set your shoulder and your pick to the glass plug.
depths-break.success_text: The glass gives with a crack like ice, and you squeeze through into the heat beyond.
depths-break.failure_text: The glass shatters the wrong way and showers you with black splinters.

depths-cut.text: The splinters slice your hands and arms.

depths-heat.text: The Burning Pits are an oven. The rock is hot to the touch and the sweat dries on you as fast as it comes.

depths-mephits.text: Two whirls of grit and spite come spinning out of a side pit.

depths-face.text: The deepest pit, where the fire burned longest. The rock is glassy and black, and in it, like seeds in fruit, sit obsidian, golden topaz and citrine.

depths-junction.text: Beyond the face the pit ends in fused rock. There's nowhere further to go.

leave.text: You climb back up into the daylight.
